blocks.text: Hamara nervous system tez raftar nervous coordination (aaza ke kaam mein rabt) karta hai, jabke endocrine system lambe arse tak chalne wale kaam qaboo karta hai, jaise growth (nashonuma), metabolism aur reproduction (tolid). Yeh kaam woh jism ke target hisson ko kimiyai hidayat (chemical instructions) bhej kar karta hai, aur yeh hidayat hormones ki shakal mein hoti hain. Isi ko chemical coordination kehte hain. Is chapter mein hum endocrine glands ke hormones aur un ke kaam parhenge.

Hormone ek regulatory (qaboo karne wala) kimiyai madda hai jo endocrine gland khoon ya tissue fluid mein chhorta hai. Khoon hormone ko jism ke har cell tak le jata hai, lekin hormone apna asar sirf apne khaas target cells mein dikhata hai. Jab target cells ko hormone milta hai to woh ek khaas tarah jawab dete hain. Isi liye hormones ko chemical messengers (kimiyai paighambar) ya signalling molecules kehte hain.

blocks.title: For Information: glands ki do qismein
blocks.text: Glands woh tissues hain jo secretions (ifrazat) banate aur chhorte hain. Jism mein do qism ke glands hain. Exocrine glands apni secretion un ducts (nalyon) mein dalte hain jo un se judi hoti hain. Endocrine glands ductless (be-nali) hote hain; woh apni secretions, jinhein hormones kehte hain, seedha khoon ya tissue fluid mein chhorte hain.

blocks.prompt: Hormone ko kimiyai paighambar (chemical messenger) kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Hormone khoon mein chhora gaya kimiyai madda hai. Khoon ise har cell tak le jata hai, magar sirf us ke target cells is ka 'paigham' parh kar khaas tarah jawab dete hain. Yani yeh gland se door ke cells tak hidayat pohanchata hai.

items: Endocrine system hormones ke zariye lambe arse ke kaam (growth, metabolism, reproduction) qaboo karta hai: chemical coordination.
Hormone khoon ke zariye har cell tak jata hai magar asar sirf target cells par karta hai.
Exocrine glands ducts mein secretion dalte hain; endocrine glands ductless hain aur hormones seedha khoon mein chhorte hain.
